senses.gloss:
ITA-2.1.3.6 śleṣaka-kaphaḥ श्लेषककफः
Lubricating kapha
Subtype of kapha seated in the joints which provides lubrication.

ITA-5.54.5 śleṣmajavraṇaḥ श्लेष्मजव्रणः
Ulcer due to vitiated kapha
An ulcer characterized by constant severe itching; thick wound margins; covered with rigid membranous vessels and ligamentous tissue; rigid (base); pale appearance; mild pain; whitish discharge; dense copious discharge; cold discharge; excessive slimy discharge; feeling of heaviness; thick/dense discharge; mild pain; feeling of being wrapped in a wet cloth; mild soddening only; taking a long time to suppurate.

ITA-3.3.16 śleṣmabhuvaḥ श्लेष्मभुवः
The hard areas on both sides of the neck

ITA-2.1.3.1 śleṣmā, kapha श्लेष्मा, कफ
Kapha, doṣha responsible for cohesiveness
One of the three regulatory functional factors responsible for stability, unctuousness, lubrication, immunity and cohesion. The predominant basic elements in kapha are earth and water.

ITA-5.66.62 śleṣmā-srāvaḥ श्लेष्मा-स्रावः
White, sticky discharge from corners of eye
A disorder characterized by white-coloured discharge; thick discharge; slimy discharge; painless discharge; profuse discharge.

IT.3.11.43 kaphāśayaḥ, śleṣmāśayaḥ कफाशय|श्लेष्माशयः Receptacle for kapha
The most prominent site of kapha: chest, stomach (upper abdomen) and head.
